title: store journal change
description: One line after a store journal's first: one write of the change, logged before it is made, so putting the change back undoes it (ADR-S22). How the lines of a journal follow each other is in the StoreJournal schema. apiVersion, kind and metadata never change; spec may grow (ADR-S15).

apiVersion.description: The form every line of a journal is in, the same as the first line's. It never changes, so two app versions both read every journal (ADR-S15).

kind.description: Always StoreJournalChange. It tells a change line apart from the first line, which carries the same apiVersion.

metadata.description: Which write of the journal it is. It never changes in v1, since every app version reads every journal by it (ADR-S15).

id.description: The write's place in the journal, counted from 1 with no gap, so a reader puts writes back last first and sees when a line is missing.

key.description: The thing written, by its key: a slash path inside the journal's scope, never a machine path (ADR-S21, S22), so putting it back never reaches outside the scope.

before.description: What the file held before the write, base64 (RFC 4648), so putting it back writes it again; an empty file is the empty string. Left out where there was no file, so putting it back removes the one the write made.

after.description: What the write leaves in the file, base64 (RFC 4648), so a reader sees whether the write was made before putting it back; an empty file is the empty string. Left out where the write removes the file.

dir.description: true when the write is to a folder, not a file: a folder made, or with gone one taken away, or with from one moved here whole. A folder has no content, so it has no before or after. Left out when false.

gone.description: true when the folder at key is taken away, so putting it back makes it again. Only with dir, never with from. Left out when false.

from.description: The key the folder at key was moved from, whole, so putting it back is one move back. Only with dir, never with gone.

spec.description: What the write does. Open: a newer app may add fields here, and an older reader accepts them (CT-RULE-4). A file write has before, after or both; a folder write has dir and no content.
